name: Blob background
what: A soft gradient blob that never stops changing shape - it breathes, turns and drifts, its colours rotate, a few sparks float - a background for words, a logo or a talking head.

learned_from.what: a teal-blue-pink blob morphing slowly on black with small particles

motion: a new shape every 36 f (S-curve), turning and drifting the whole time; sparks rise slowly
